name: ai-interview-assistant
description: AI Interview Assistant – prepare for and perform better in technical interviews

scripts.dev: npm run build:shared && concurrently -n shared,server,client -c gray,green,cyan "npm run dev -w @aia/shared" "npm run dev -w @aia/server" "npm run dev -w @aia/client"
scripts.build: npm run build:shared && npm run build -w @aia/server && npm run build -w @aia/client && npm run build -w @aia/desktop
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:shared && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test: npm run build:shared && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.seed: npm run build:shared && npm run seed -w @aia/server
